description: Keep clean-room work away from prey and block unsafe prey-cache shell commands. Each hook runs hooks/guard.py from the plugin root with the first Python the shell finds; the launcher imports the guard from the plugin's own src/, so nothing has to be installed. Exit 2 is a guard's refusal and nothing else; a launcher that cannot run says so and exits 1, which Claude Code shows and proceeds on.

hooks.command: g="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; [ -f "$g" ] || { echo "crab: guard launcher missing at $g; the tool call proceeds unguarded" >&2; exit 1; }; case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) c="python python3";; *) c="python3 python";; esac; for p in $c; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" -I "$g" cleanroom; done; echo "crab: no python on PATH to run the clean-room guard; the tool call proceeds unguarded" >&2; exit 1

g="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; [ -f "$g" ] || { echo "crab: guard launcher missing at $g; the tool call proceeds unguarded" >&2; exit 1; }; case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) c="python python3";; *) c="python3 python";; esac; for p in $c; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" -I "$g" prey; done; echo "crab: no python on PATH to run the prey guard; the tool call proceeds unguarded" >&2; exit 1
